summary: Earn scores with mixed color guessing, color sorting, and color name quizzes.
description:
IROMAZE Ink Shop is an ink shop that bottles and ships mysterious ink spirits.
The ink spirit "Ink-chan" has a habit of happily entering the bottle when it shows the same color as itself.
Please note that many Ink-chans will appear at the same time, and in that case, the color must be a mixture of all Ink-chans.
Let's quickly show Ink-chan the correct color before she runs away!
In addition, the finished bottles must be sorted in the specified order in order to be delivered to the customer.
If you line them up correctly in order of brightness, you might get a bonus!
Sort them carefully and in the correct order!

Now is the time to put your color sense to full use.
Let's work together with the store manager Coco to fill Ink-chan into bottles and ship them side by side to get a high score!

We are also planning to implement a collection element “Color Gacha” as a bonus mode.
By collecting bonus stars and spinning the gacha to collect colors, you can learn the names of colors and freely color scheme Coco's costume.
Let's enjoy a variety of colors at the IROMAZE ink shop!
